verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a bulk export of all account data in open formats or any offboarding path. Warehouse Sync is inbound: it ingests data from your warehouse into mParticle. The integration and forwarding items only describe routing incoming event streams to downstream vendors and warehouses, which is an adjacent capability rather than a full data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
